headline: Eight more classics play themselves at the press of Y
lede: WATCH rollout batch 1 lands the pilot's one-key guide on the classic-arcade family: QBert, Joust, Galaga, Tempest, Dig Dug, Bubble Bobble, Spy Hunter and Arkanoid now ride their own proven autopilots at full speed — and the second you touch a key, pad or the screen, the game is yours again, exactly where the watcher left it.

notes.text: The watchers are the provers: each game's own solver drives (BFS cube-hops, the joust rider policy, Galaga's greedy pilot, Tempest's slack-scheduled rim defence, tunnelling, bubble graph-riding, lane modelling, paddle aiming) — the same functions the Node harnesses grade, so watching is proof, not theatre.

Takeover is total and honest: any driving key, pad push or tap hands the controls back mid-route; Y again re-seats the prover from wherever you got to. Bubble Bobble guides seat 1 only — your friend keeps seat 2.

watchcheck gained an arcade pilot factory — 9 assertions per game (start, advance, still-watching, takeover, re-seat, resume, release) with prover-only tests: Tempest and Spy Hunter must hold lives where an idle player dies, Arkanoid must score where an idle paddle never launches the ball.

Studio-wide caveat: dev-mode Chrome broke for every lane tonight (split React dep graph, #1622-adjacent) — the new browser legs are wired and will run the moment Chrome recovers; merge rode the lint+build bar.
